name: River Raid Player Jet Scene
instruction: Create a Player scene with a CharacterBody2D root named Player, add an AnimatedSprite2D that autoplay the default animation and includes looping default/left/right jet frames from assets/sprites/sprites-Sheet.png and a non-looping explode sequence from the smoke sprites at assets/sprites/Free Smoke Fx  Pixel 04.png, and attach a 16×16 rectangular CollisionShape2D that fits the jet.

metadata.tutorial_source: YouTube: CyberPotato - [BETTER SOUND REUPLOAD] How to make River Raid Atari Classic in Godot 4 - Tutorial
metadata.transcript_excerpt: we will start by creating a new scene ... our player will be based on character body to D ... add child node ... animated Sprite Tod ... we will need a collision shape ... we can add of course the explosion animation because it can be destroyed
